title: The Expires field must be a parseable date

spec.name: RFC 9116
spec.normative_quote: The value of this field MUST be formatted as a datetime string as specified in [RFC5322], which security.txt implementations are RECOMMENDED to represent using the ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 profile.
spec.note: Recalled from training-data familiarity with the published RFC, not re-verified against a live fetch this session (this agent has no WebFetch access). The deferred drift probe (ADR 0011 follow-up (h)) must reconcile this quote against a live re-fetch of spec.url before it is treated as verified.

applicability: A security.txt body containing an Expires: field whose value does not parse as a date.

cases.name: Expires value is not a date
Expires value parses cleanly -- this rule does not fire
